This same addition should definitely be made to section VIII-BO as an impact of closing all bol lands to ONV use. Not only would trespass continue to increase, with consequent strain upon police and enforcement resources, but there would probably be an increase of unexplained acts of vandalism, arson, etc. on the part of otherwise law-abiding citizens angered at being shut out of 35 hol lands.
In writing the final draft, I think that it would behoove the BOF to specifically mention motorcycles by their generic name where appropriate. It appears ludicrous to continually refer to "dune-buppies, showmobiles and other off-road vehicles" when what we are really talking about is some 4 million motorcycles and a few Lundred thousand of the rest.
In conclusion, I hope that it can be stressed that "public participation" should be, MUST be solicited not only to the letter of the draft, but also in the spirit of enlightened public notice. For example, we received the draft statement only 3 days before the deadline for coment. I have yet to be able to obtain the draft proposal of BLM policy on ONV use. Most of the public hearings are kept a deep, dark secret from the motorcycle enthusiast press. Were it not for our thousands of readers keeping us informed, we would know of very few actions or proposed actions on the part of public land management agencies.
